en.headline: Red flags hoisted at Stanley, Shek O and Big Wave Bay beaches
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said big waves prompted the red flags on Tuesday and advised beachgoers not to swim at the three Southern District beaches.
body: Red flags have been hoisted at three beaches on Hong Kong Island due to big waves, the Leisure and Cultural Services Department announced on Tuesday.
The flags are in force at Stanley Main Beach, Shek O Beach and Big Wave Bay Beach in the Southern District. Beachgoers are advised not to swim at these locations.
The department issued the announcement in the morning after assessing conditions. Red flags indicate that swimming is not recommended because of the risk posed by waves or other hazards.

zh.headline: 赤柱、石澳及大浪灣泳灘因大浪懸掛紅旗
zh.dek: 康文署表示周二因大浪在三個南區泳灘懸掛紅旗，呼籲泳客不要下水。
body: 康樂及文化事務署周二宣布，因大浪關係，香港島三個泳灘已懸掛紅旗。
涉及泳灘為南區的赤柱正灘、石澳泳灘及大浪灣泳灘。署方呼籲泳客不要在這些泳灘游泳。
署方上午評估情況後發出公告。紅旗表示因波浪或其他危險，不建議游泳。
